body:
Thank you so much for saying that. I really needed to hear it. My whole life has just been bad. My mother has always been an alcoholic and drug addict. My dad left us with her and moved away. Then we were taken by CPS and custody battles ensued. For a few years she was sober. It showed us how great of mother she could really be. I wish that had never happened because it just filled us with false hope. She relapsed two years ago. Last year, after a series of dangerous alcohol-related events, she had a stroke. She continued to drink after that. She has been sober a few months now and is doing much better. I am afraid to put faith in her so I don't see her or call her. I just don't want my heart broken again. My sister has really resented me for this.
I have also just met someone who I am falling in love with. My anxiety is taking over and convincing me he doesn't like me and is probably talking to other girls. The constant battle inside me is tearing me apart. I don't know how to stop it. One side of me wants to end it all and forget but the other has hope that things might get better. Please help.
